concepts.prompt:
Generate a high-fidelity mobile app UI design board for SOCIALLY, a Solana social-investing product. This is a NEW visual proposal. The previous concepts were rejected: they repeated beach photos, giant serif headings, generic soft cards, slogans and very similar layouts. Make a markedly stronger, product-specific design. Landscape board with THREE impeccably typeset large mobile screens, straight-on, no device shells, consistent 393px logical screen widths, generous readable type. Left: Crew Discover CAPTAINS tab. Middle: Crew Discover VAULTS tab. Right: public Captain detail with performance from Crew investor perspective. Two tabs Captains / Vaults on both Discover screens, a search field whose placeholder changes from "Search @username" to "Search vault name", a filter button and small relevant filter/sort chips. Show independent image banner AND circular avatar for both Captain cards and Vault cards; vault avatars should be custom fund emblems, never replace with the captain portrait. Use original, art-directed abstract financial/editorial banners, not stock beaches or generic gradients. Captains have names and @usernames, period-labeled return, AUM and View vaults action. Vaults have name, @captain, Fundraising/Active status, duration, participant count and available capacity in USDC. Avoid unexplained strategy filters, fake verification marks, category slogans and APY. Captain performance: Maya Chen @maya, 30D +8.4% net return, max drawdown −4.2%, AUM 124,500 USDC, Crew 128, Active vaults 3, date and percent axes, chart ending exactly +8.4%, 7D/30D/90D/All, "Paper trading · Sample data", "Net of assessed fees", "Captain portfolio return", Explore vaults CTA. Performance is not personal Crew return. Fundraising vault has no return, use Not started if needed. Bottom nav Home Discover Wallet Settings, Discover selected. Keep visible copy short and real. Match existing brand foundation: midnight navy #182B43, glacier-blue #E6EFF8, cool off-white #F5F7FB, restrained green #16805E, readable Inter labels with occasional Cormorant serif. Use mock data and legible clean numbers. Output one finished image containing all three screens with a very small concept number in the exterior margin.
CONCEPT 06. Create an information-led premium investment marketplace. White/light ice background, compact sans-serif Discover heading, sharply aligned stacked comparison rows with narrow abstract banner ribbons and overlapping portrait/emblem. Rich navy typography. Main discovery list feels like a carefully designed fund directory, not social feed. Returns and AUM form consistent columns across entries. The performance screen has a large navy chart module and quiet lower metric rows. Make the search and tab controls unusually crisp. Banner graphics resemble elegant layered blue paper sculpture and precise market contour art.

CONCEPT 07. Create a bold dark-navy design using the app's navy and pale glacier palette inverted. Deep ink canvas, subtly lighter flat cards, bright off-white typography, pale cyan selected tab, mint only for gains. Wide abstract image banners look like architectural folded metal and frost under directional studio light, with distinct portrait crops and fund emblems. One featured Captain card above two compact entries. Vault cards emphasize fundraising progress as a clear track with numeric remaining capacity. Detail uses an expansive percentage chart against dark background, elegant metric typography. No neon, no purple, no glow.

CONCEPT 08. Create a warm editorial investment journal direction while preserving navy brand identity. Warm white page with very light glacier tab/search controls, finely ruled separators and restrained serif names. Distinctive asymmetric cards: a thin panoramic abstract navy-and-sand collage banner, portrait anchored to left, financial facts to right, short narrative below. Vault imagery uses printed geometric artworks and tactile paper compositions rather than photography. Captain detail feels like a precise public investor factsheet, clear performance chart and a restrained 2x2 statistics section. Avoid all slogans. This is a premium finance product, not a magazine landing page.

CONCEPT 09. Create a modern compact discovery workspace with a subtle blue tinted backdrop, segmented tabs and large simple searchable field. Pair one substantial featured card with TWO-COLUMN compact secondary Captain tiles; preserve banner plus avatar on every tile, prioritize name @handle and 30D return, keep all text readable. Vault screen uses two-column image tiles with each fund's own cover and round emblem, two examples Fundraising and two Active, concise key facts. Keep filters in a single tidy horizontal row. Captain performance uses a full-width white chart with excellent spacing, low-contrast gridlines and a large typography-led gain. Distinct grid-based composition with clear hierarchy, no stock photography.

CONCEPT 10. Create a sophisticated precision-finance interface, closest to production iOS app craftsmanship. Pale silver-blue app background with full-width flat white sections, a horizontally scrollable banner-led featured Captain strip, then tightly designed rows with slim individual image banners and round avatars. Vault tab includes a visible FILTER BOTTOM SHEET covering the lower 40% with Phase All/Fundraising/Active, Duration Under 30 days/30+ days, sort Newest/AUM, Clear and Show vaults controls. Above it preserve independent vault cover and emblem. Profile has a small banner/portrait identity header, horizontally arranged return and drawdown, a beautifully crisp net-return chart, a thin labeled coverage strip and minimal public stats. Use the strongest possible spacing and alignment; no giant headings or decorative slogans.
